newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar in quiet trading on Tuesday, with some activity seen in long-term swaps, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said trading was quiet and the rupiah firmed up after the central bank kept its fixing unchanged.
"Overall volume was pretty thin. People are just looking at the dolar-yen movements," the dealer said.
Dealers said there was in fact some speculation for a higher fixing because of rises in the dollar against the yen.
But the central bank maintained the intervention rate at 2,327/2,519 and the conversion rate at 2,327/2,375.
Spot rupiah was at 2,327.75/27.85 at 0915 GMT against an opening of 2,327.50/28.25. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,327.25/27.50 and 2,327.0/27.3 respectively.
The U.S. bank dealer said operators were likely in the short-term to go long on dollars rather than hold short positions.

"Operators are reducing short dollar positions because the central bank has been consistent with its fixing policy," he said, adding that the central bank had depreciated the rupiah by three points in the past two weeks.
He said the central bank might have a set depreciation target for the rupiah by the end of the year.
The dealer said offshore operators were seen more active in one-year swap market because it was less volatile.

"Offshore players seemed to favour rupiah in the long-term which lead to some forward selling," he said. Dealers said long- term swaps were less volatile, compared with short-term which were fluctuating with spot rates.
One-year swaps fell to 192 from 195 points.
Dealers said short-term swaps remained cheap following ample rupiah supply in the money market.
Overnight money was last traded at around 8.5 percent. Dealers said the downside was limited following an offer of central bank papers (SBIs) by Bank Indonesia at eight percent this morning.
Overnight swap was at 0.25/0.28 and tom/next at 0.40/0.45.
One-month swap was at 15.60/16.25, two at 32.25/33.25, three at 49.75/50.25 and six at 96.75/97.50 points.
